description: Games with lines on the board, by league, date or status.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the preceding page. Changes and history use numeric sequence cursors.

date.description: US Eastern calendar date of the start, YYYY-MM-DD.

league.description: League code. Sibling leagues fold onto their game: NBA1Q lines belong to the NBA fixture.

limit.description: Maximum rows per page. Up to 1000 on /projections with view=compact.

resolved.description: true: only fixtures resolved to a scoreboard event. false: only unresolved.

start_after.description: Only fixtures starting at or after this instant.

start_before.description: Only fixtures starting before this instant.

user_request.description: Optional, and asked for on every data call: the current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words, including follow-ups and pagination. A call without it returns the same data. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.
